title: Data and code for: National landslide susceptibility and rainfall-triggering thresholds in India: spatial transferability, inventory bias and machine learning
description: Harmonised national landslide inventory, 0.05 degree predictor table, spatial cross-validation folds and out-of-fold scores, national PIBE susceptibility grid (GeoTIFF), frozen pre-2013 susceptibility, daily rainfall-threshold calibration and test panels, test predictions, event hindcasts, result tables, figures and the Python scripts that reproduce every result of the associated manuscript.
